claim: GOVERNANCE.md:37-39 says the separation of roles is 'Enforced, not just agreed'. It is not. (1) Every role may write a Python script into its own folder and run it (e10_run_roles.sh:10-12). Python runs with the full rights of the shared Unix user, so any role can change code, the archive, DECISIONS.md, other roles' verdicts or the role prompts. 'python -I' is no barrier: one line puts site-packages back on the path, as roles/redteam/_env.py does. (2) Read / Glob / Grep reach the whole project, so blinding (line 13: verifier and safety do not see the designer's reasoning) and private role folders (line 32) depend on good behaviour only. Roles run in parallel (e10:15-17 '&'), so each can read the others' verdicts while writing its own, and the file names in the verifier's folder already reveal its topics. (3) The 'append-only' board (line 30) is not enforced: each role may Edit its own verdict at any time, including after reading the others. (4) The red team can rewrite or delete any finding, including after the integrator has answered it, while the roles that line 24 says 'reply in the finding' have no write access to findings/. (5) The integrator owns the code and the archive, writes the digest, ISSUES.md and DECISIONS.md, and judges findings against its own code. This conflicts with line 9 ('no role approves its own work'). (6) PLAN.md:50 sends verdicts to human_study/evo/rounds/<n>/, GOVERNANCE.md to board/rNNNN/.

fix_options.option: Real isolation: run each role as its own Unix user (or container) with read-only bind mounts of the project and a writable mount only for roles/<role>/ and its board file; findings/ append-only via a small submit script owned by the integrator

Cheaper: remove the 'Bash(python ...)' permission; roles that need computation submit a script to a runner that executes it in a sandbox (copy of the project, no write-back except the role folder); hash board files at round close and store hashes in the digest

Process: run roles sequentially or snapshot-and-hide the board until all verdicts are in; a second party (PI or verifier) rules on findings that target integrator code; fix PLAN.md:50 path; state honestly in GOVERNANCE.md what is enforced vs agreed

summary_zh: 治理文件寫著「角色分工有技術強制，不只是約定」，實際上並沒有強制。（1）每個角色都可以在自己的資料夾寫一支 Python 程式並執行，而 Python 擁有整個專案的寫入權限，所以任何角色都能改程式碼、資料庫、決策紀錄，甚至別的角色的判定。紅隊用只檢查、不寫入的方式確認了這一點。（2）每個角色都能讀整個專案，所以「盲測」與「私人資料夾」只靠自律；四個角色又是同時執行，可以互相偷看判定。（3）「只能新增、不能修改」的公告板沒有強制。（4）紅隊可以改寫已經被回覆的發現，被要求回覆的角色卻沒有寫入權。（5）整合者負責寫程式，又負責評判針對自己程式的發現，違反「不能審核自己工作」的原則。建議：每個角色改用獨立的系統帳號或容器執行，並唯讀掛載整個專案。
